# Error #95: RefundTargetUnchanged

## Summary

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::RefundTargetUnchanged` — the address already holds the refund claim, so routing to it changes nothing.

---

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::routing_to_the_address_that_already_holds_the_claim_is_refused`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::routing_to_the_address_that_already_holds_the_claim_is_refused). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// RefundTargetUnchanged — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let id = f.create_stream(DEPOSIT, DAY, 10 * DAY, false);
// The sender already holds the claim, so routing to them is the
// no-op this branch exists to refuse.
Some(rejected!(f
    .client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .try_set_refund_target(&f.sender, &id, &f.sender)))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked routing_to_the_address_that_already_holds_the_claim_is_refused
```

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Choose a refund target different from the address that already holds the refund claim; routing to the same address is a no-op and reverts.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#20-refund-routing`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#20-refund-routing)
